text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. It was the Tier 2 escalation for Tansleigh Packaging (TSP): the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 froze on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that message himself.

I didn't mention Ticket #4912. It's a different Door 6 problem (a phantom lock when flatbeds check in at the guard shack), and it only appears in an email that Hollis may not be able to see.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in the thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, and Tobias is a member there. The Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply (MAS) is attached to that ticket. The open issue at the time was that the import file labels doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02.

Other Marrow Agrisupply tickets came up in the search, but they're about different problems, so I left them out of the reply.
